vulnerable_code:
class RepositorySerializer < ActiveModel::Serializer
  attributes :id, :slug, :visibility, :clone_url

  # Embeds private deploy keys and secrets for any user who can read repository metadata
  has_many :deploy_keys
end

class RepositoriesController < ApplicationController
  def show
    repo = Repository.find(params[:id])
    render json: repo
  end
end
diagnosis: RepositorySerializer renders the deploy_keys association without checking repository admin privileges. Any user with read-only access to a code repository can extract private SSH deployment keys and signing secrets.
exploit_request:
GET /api/repos/repo_3391 HTTP/1.1
Host: git.developer-forge.io
Authorization: Bearer contractor_read_token
Accept: application/json
corrected_code:
class RepositorySerializer < ActiveModel::Serializer
  attributes :id, :slug, :visibility, :clone_url

  has_many :deploy_keys, if: :admin_viewer?

  def admin_viewer?
    scope&.admin_of?(object)
  end
end

class RepositoriesController < ApplicationController
  def show
    repo = Repository.find(params[:id])
    render json: repo
  end
end
